name: Kami no Machi
source:
Kannai town in Yokohama became a ground for a major incident and turned into a limited zone. The lawless city of "Agarta" rose on its place. Two years after the incident a young man Yuuki sets for Agartha in search of his lover missed after the incident. 

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
横滨关内因一场重大事件沦为禁区，无法无天的城市“阿加尔塔”在废墟上兴起。事件发生两年后，青年勇树前往阿加尔塔，寻找当年失踪的恋人。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
